001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005import org.clafer.assertion.Assertion;
006import org.clafer.ast.AstBoolExpr;
007import org.clafer.ast.AstCard;
008import org.clafer.ast.AstChildRelation;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.AstCompare;
011import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
012import org.clafer.ast.AstConstant;
013import org.clafer.ast.AstConstraint;
014import org.clafer.ast.AstExpr;
015import org.clafer.ast.AstExprRewriter;
016import org.clafer.ast.AstGlobal;
017import org.clafer.ast.AstIfThenElse;
018import org.clafer.ast.AstJoin;
019import org.clafer.ast.AstJoinParent;
020import org.clafer.ast.AstJoinRef;
021import org.clafer.ast.AstMembership;
022import org.clafer.ast.AstNot;
023import org.clafer.ast.AstSetExpr;
024import org.clafer.ast.AstSetTest;
025import org.clafer.ast.AstThis;
026import org.clafer.ast.AstUpcast;
027import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.compare;
028import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.constant;
029import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.equal;
030import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.global;
031import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.ifThenElse;
032import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.join;
033import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.membership;
034import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.test;
035import org.clafer.ast.Card;
036import org.clafer.ast.ProductType;
037import org.clafer.common.Util;
038import org.clafer.objective.Objective;
039
040/**
041 * Optimizes the expressions inside the constraints. Assumes type checking has
042 * already passed.
043 *
044 * @author jimmy
045 */
046public class OptimizerAnalyzer extends AstExprRewriter<Analysis> implements Analyzer {
047
048    @Override
049    public Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
050        Map<AstConstraint, AstBoolExpr> constraintExprs = new HashMap<>(analysis.getConstraints().size());
051        for (AstConstraint constraint : analysis.getConstraints()) {
052            constraintExprs.put(constraint, rewrite(analysis.getExpr(constraint), analysis));
053        }
054        Map<Objective, AstSetExpr> objectiveExprs = new HashMap<>(analysis.getObjectives().length);
055        for (Objective objective : analysis.getObjectives()) {
056            objectiveExprs.put(objective, rewrite(analysis.getExpr(objective), analysis));
057        }
058        Map<Assertion, AstBoolExpr> assertionExprs = new HashMap<>(analysis.getAssertions().length);
059        for (Assertion assertion : analysis.getAssertions()) {
060            assertionExprs.put(assertion, rewrite(analysis.getExpr(assertion), analysis));
061        }
062        return analysis
063                .setConstraintExprs(constraintExprs)
064                .setObjectiveExprs(objectiveExprs)
065                .setAssertionExprs(assertionExprs);
066    }
067
068    @Override
069    public AstExpr visit(AstGlobal ast, Analysis a) {
070        Card globalCard = a.getGlobalCard(ast.type());
071        if (globalCard.isExact() && (a.getFormat(ast.type()).equals(Format.LowGroup) || globalCard.getLow() == 1)) {
072            return constant(ast.type(), Util.fromTo(0, globalCard.getLow()));
073        }
074        return ast;
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public AstExpr visit(AstJoin ast, Analysis a) {
079        if (ast.right() instanceof AstChildRelation) {
080            AstSetExpr left = rewrite(ast.left(), a);
081            AstClafer right = ((AstChildRelation) ast.right()).childType();
082            if (left instanceof AstGlobal) {
083                return global(right);
084            } else if (left instanceof AstConstant && right instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
085                // TODO what if right is abstract?
086                Card childCard = a.getCard((AstConcreteClafer) right);
087                if (Format.ParentGroup.equals(a.getFormat(right))) {
088                    AstConstant constant = (AstConstant) left;
089                    if (constant.type().arity() == 1) {
090                        int[] value = constant.value()[0];
091                        assert childCard.isExact();
092                        int[] childConstant = new int[value.length * childCard.getLow()];
093                        for (int i = 0; i < constant.value().length; i++) {
094                            for (int j = 0; j < childCard.getLow(); j++) {
095                                childConstant[i * childCard.getLow() + j]
096                                        = i * value[i] + j;
097                            }
098                        }
099                        return constant(right, childConstant);
100                    }
101                }
102                assert childCard.getLow() != a.getScope(right) :
103                        "Didn't run scope analysis before format analysis?";
104            }
105            return join(left, ast.right());
106        }
107        return ast;
108    }
109
110    @Override
111    public AstExpr visit(AstJoinParent ast, Analysis a) {
112        AstSetExpr children = rewrite(ast.children(), a);
113        if (children instanceof AstThis) {
114            ProductType type = a.getCommonSupertype(ast);
115            if (a.getScope(type) == 1) {
116                return constant(type, 0);
117            }
118        } else if (children instanceof AstGlobal) {
119            ProductType childType = a.getCommonSupertype(ast.children());
120            if (childType.isClaferType()) {
121                AstClafer childClafer = childType.getClaferType();
122                if (childClafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
123                    AstConcreteClafer concreteChildType = (AstConcreteClafer) childClafer;
124                    if (a.getCard(concreteChildType).hasLow()) {
125                        return global(concreteChildType.getParent());
126                    }
127                }
128            }
129        } else if (children instanceof AstConstant) {
130            AstConstant constant = (AstConstant) children;
131            ProductType type = a.getCommonSupertype(ast);
132            if (constant.value().length > 0 && a.getScope(type) == 1) {
133                return constant(type, 0);
134            }
135        }
136        return ast;
137    }
138    // TDODO: rewrite for all (global)
139
140    @Override
141    public AstExpr visit(AstNot ast, Analysis a) {
142        AstBoolExpr expr = ast.expr();
143        if (expr instanceof AstNot) {
144            AstNot not = (AstNot) expr;
145            return not.expr();
146        } else if (expr instanceof AstSetTest) {
147            AstSetTest test = (AstSetTest) expr;
148            return test(test.left(), test.op().negate(), test.right());
149        } else if (expr instanceof AstCompare) {
150            AstCompare compare = (AstCompare) expr;
151            return compare(compare.left(), compare.op().negate(), compare.right());
152        } else if (expr instanceof AstMembership) {
153            AstMembership membership = (AstMembership) expr;
154            return membership(membership.member(), membership.op().negate(), membership.set());
155        }
156        return ast;
157    }
158
159    private boolean isZero(AstSetExpr expr) {
160        if (expr instanceof AstConstant) {
161            AstConstant constant = (AstConstant) expr;
162            if (constant.type().isInt()) {
163                if (constant.value().length == 1) {
164                    return constant.value()[0].length == 1 && constant.value()[0][0] == 0;
165                }
166            }
167        }
168        return false;
169    }
170
171    private AstSetExpr removeUpCast(AstSetExpr expr) {
172        if (expr instanceof AstUpcast) {
173            return removeUpCast(((AstUpcast) expr).base());
174        }
175        return expr;
176    }
177
178    private AstExpr rewriteIfThenElse(AstBoolExpr antecedent,
179            AstSetExpr consequentLeft, AstSetExpr consequentRight, AstSetExpr alternativeLeft, AstSetExpr alternativeRight,
180            Analysis analysis) {
181        // rewrite
182        //   if a then b = c else b = d
183        // to
184        //   b = (if a then c else d)
185        if (consequentLeft.equals(alternativeLeft)) {
186            return equal(consequentLeft,
187                    ifThenElse(antecedent, consequentRight, alternativeRight));
188        }
189        // rewrite
190        //   if a then b = c else none b
191        // to
192        //   b = (if a then c else {})
193        if (consequentLeft instanceof AstJoinRef) {
194            AstJoinRef joinRef = (AstJoinRef) consequentLeft;
195            if (alternativeLeft instanceof AstCard && isZero(alternativeRight)) {
196                AstCard card = (AstCard) alternativeLeft;
197                if (removeUpCast(joinRef.deref()).equals(removeUpCast(card.set()))) {
198                    return equal(consequentLeft,
199                            ifThenElse(antecedent,
200                                    consequentRight,
201                                    constant(analysis.getType(consequentRight).getCommonSupertype().getClaferType())
202                            ));
203                }
204            }
205        }
206
207        return null;
208    }
209
210    @Override
211    public AstExpr visit(AstIfThenElse ast, Analysis a) {
212        if (ast.consequent() instanceof AstSetTest && ast.alternative() instanceof AstSetTest) {
213            AstBoolExpr antecedent = ast.antecedent();
214            AstSetTest consequent = (AstSetTest) ast.consequent();
215            AstSetTest alternative = (AstSetTest) ast.alternative();
216
217            AstExpr rewrite = rewriteIfThenElse(antecedent, consequent.left(), consequent.right(), alternative.left(), alternative.right(), a);
218            if (rewrite != null) {
219                return rewrite;
220            }
221            rewrite = rewriteIfThenElse(antecedent, consequent.left(), consequent.right(), alternative.right(), alternative.left(), a);
222            if (rewrite != null) {
223                return rewrite;
224            }
225            rewrite = rewriteIfThenElse(antecedent, consequent.right(), consequent.left(), alternative.left(), alternative.right(), a);
226            if (rewrite != null) {
227                return rewrite;
228            }
229            rewrite = rewriteIfThenElse(antecedent, consequent.right(), consequent.left(), alternative.right(), alternative.left(), a);
230            if (rewrite != null) {
231                return rewrite;
232            }
233        }
234        return ast;
235    }
236}
